stories.title: Apple Cuts More Than 200 Jobs From Siri and Vision Pro Teams
stories.summary: Apple reportedly cut more than 200 jobs across its Siri and Vision Pro software teams. Engadget, TechCrunch, and The Verge all reported the cuts, which hit staff working on the voice assistant and the mixed-reality headset. Apple has not given a public reason for the layoffs.
stories.whyItMatters: The cuts signal a shift in priority or budget for two of Apple's most closely watched, and most criticized, product efforts.
whatToWatch: Whether Apple confirms the layoffs or explains the reason.
Any change in the pace of Siri's promised overhaul.
Whether Vision Pro's strategy shifts after the cuts.

stories.title: Hibernation Causes Major Loss of Synapses in Mice, Study Finds
stories.summary: Ars Technica reported on a study that found putting mice into hibernation causes a major loss of synapses, the connections between brain cells. The finding raises questions about what happens to the brain during deep hibernation-like states. The report did not say whether the loss is permanent.
stories.whyItMatters: The study could shape future research on brain health and any medical use of induced hibernation-like states.
whatToWatch: Follow-up research on whether synapses regrow after mice wake.
questions: Do the synapses return once the mice come out of hibernation?

stories.summary: Ars Technica reported that dismantling the Roadless Rule threatens to disrupt wildlife and water supplies in the US. The rule has long limited road building and logging in protected national forest land. The report warns of ecological harm if the rule is removed.
stories.whyItMatters: The rule's fate affects millions of acres of forest, along with the wildlife and water systems that depend on them.
whatToWatch: Any formal decision or timeline on repealing the rule.

stories.title: NASA Cancels Rescue Mission for the Aging Swift Telescope
stories.summary: Wired reported that NASA canceled its planned rescue mission for the aging Swift telescope. Swift has spent years observing gamma-ray bursts and other high-energy cosmic events. The cancellation raises questions about how much longer the telescope will keep working.
stories.whyItMatters: Losing or shortening Swift's mission would reduce astronomers' ability to catch fast-changing cosmic events in real time.
whatToWatch: Whether NASA sets a new end-of-life plan or decommissioning date for Swift.
questions: Why was the rescue mission canceled — cost, feasibility, or priority?
